delivery_booking_review_proof_valid.name: delivery_booking_review_proof_valid
delivery_booking_review_proof_valid.value:
"delivery_booking_reviews"."proof_source" = 'jubelio_confirmation' and
        "delivery_booking_reviews"."absence_confirmed" is true and "delivery_booking_reviews"."operation_closed" is true

delivery_shipment_costs_finite_nonnegati.name: delivery_shipment_costs_finite_nonnegative
delivery_shipment_costs_finite_nonnegati.value:
("delivery_shipment"."quote_rates" >= 0 and "delivery_shipment"."quote_rates"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')) and
        ("delivery_shipment"."booked_price" is null or ("delivery_shipment"."booked_price" >= 0 and "delivery_shipment"."booked_price"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity'))) and
        ("delivery_shipment"."billed_price" is null or ("delivery_shipment"."billed_price" >= 0 and "delivery_shipment"."billed_price"::text not in ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')))

delivery_shipment_booked_fields_present.name: delivery_shipment_booked_fields_present
delivery_shipment_booked_fields_present.value:
("delivery_shipment"."state" <> 'booked' or ("delivery_shipment"."awb" is not null and "delivery_shipment"."shipment_id" is not null
         and "delivery_shipment"."booked_price" is not null and "delivery_shipment"."booked_by" is not null and "delivery_shipment"."dispatched_at" is not null))

delivery_shipment_ambiguity_fields_absen.name: delivery_shipment_ambiguity_fields_absent
delivery_shipment_ambiguity_fields_absen.value:
("delivery_shipment"."state" not in ('packed', 'booking_dispatched', 'booking_unknown') or
         ("delivery_shipment"."awb" is null and "delivery_shipment"."shipment_id" is null and
          "delivery_shipment"."booked_price" is null and "delivery_shipment"."billed_price" is null and "delivery_shipment"."booked_at" is null))

delivery_shipment_handoff_fields_present.name: delivery_shipment_handoff_fields_present
delivery_shipment_handoff_fields_present.value: ("delivery_shipment"."handed_over_at" is null or ("delivery_shipment"."booked_at" is not null and "delivery_shipment"."handed_over_by" is not null))

order_item_pricing_snapshot_complete.name: order_item_pricing_snapshot_complete
order_item_pricing_snapshot_complete.value:
"order_item"."pricing_contract_version" <> 1 or (
        "order_item"."source_unit_price" is not null
        and "order_item"."source_unit_price" >= 0
        and "order_item"."source_unit_price" = trunc("order_item"."source_unit_price")
        and "order_item"."source_unit_price" <= 9999999999999
        and "order_item"."markdown_amount" is not null
        and "order_item"."markdown_amount" >= 0
        and "order_item"."markdown_amount" = trunc("order_item"."markdown_amount")
        and "order_item"."markdown_amount" <= 9999999999999
        and "order_item"."goods_discount_amount" is not null
        and "order_item"."goods_discount_amount" >= 0
        and "order_item"."goods_discount_amount" = trunc("order_item"."goods_discount_amount")
        and "order_item"."goods_discount_amount" <= 9999999999999
        and "order_item"."net_line_amount" is not null
        and "order_item"."net_line_amount" >= 0
        and "order_item"."net_line_amount" = trunc("order_item"."net_line_amount")
        and "order_item"."net_line_amount" <= 9999999999999
        and "order_item"."price" >= 0
        and "order_item"."price" = trunc("order_item"."price")
        and "order_item"."price" <= 9999999999999
        and ("order_item"."markdown_revision_id" is null or length("order_item"."markdown_revision_id") <= 128)
      )

orders_delivery_manual_fields_complete.name: orders_delivery_manual_fields_complete
orders_delivery_manual_fields_complete.value:
("orders"."delivery_manual_reason" is null or ("orders"."delivery_manual_reason" <> ''
         and "orders"."delivery_manual_at" is not null and "orders"."delivery_manual_by" is not null))

orders_delivery_failure_manual_exclusive.name: orders_delivery_failure_manual_exclusive
orders_delivery_failure_manual_exclusive.value: not ("orders"."delivery_failure_code" is not null and "orders"."delivery_manual_reason" is not null)

orders_pricing_amounts_nonnegative.name: orders_pricing_amounts_nonnegative
orders_pricing_amounts_nonnegative.value:
("orders"."source_goods_subtotal" is null or "orders"."source_goods_subtotal" >= 0)
        and ("orders"."markdown_total" is null or "orders"."markdown_total" >= 0)
        and ("orders"."net_goods" is null or "orders"."net_goods" >= 0)
        and ("orders"."shipping_before_subsidy" is null or "orders"."shipping_before_subsidy" >= 0)
        and ("orders"."shipping_subsidy" is null or "orders"."shipping_subsidy" >= 0)
        and ("orders"."merchant_funding" is null or "orders"."merchant_funding" >= 0)
        and ("orders"."taxable_base" is null or "orders"."taxable_base" >= 0)
        and ("orders"."expected_provider_payable" is null or "orders"."expected_provider_payable" >= 0)
        and ("orders"."provider_quoted_shipping_cost" is null or "orders"."provider_quoted_shipping_cost" >= 0)
        and ("orders"."provider_billed_shipping_cost" is null or "orders"."provider_billed_shipping_cost" >= 0)

orders_pricing_snapshot_complete.value:

        "orders"."pricing_currency" is not null
        and "orders"."pricing_currency" = 'IDR'
        and "orders"."pricing_snapshot" is not null
        and "orders"."source_goods_subtotal" is not null
        and "orders"."source_goods_subtotal" >= 0
        and "orders"."source_goods_subtotal" = trunc("orders"."source_goods_subtotal")
        and "orders"."source_goods_subtotal" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."markdown_total" is not null
        and "orders"."markdown_total" >= 0
        and "orders"."markdown_total" = trunc("orders"."markdown_total")
        and "orders"."markdown_total" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."net_goods" is not null
        and "orders"."net_goods" >= 0
        and "orders"."net_goods" = trunc("orders"."net_goods")
        and "orders"."net_goods" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."shipping_before_subsidy" is not null
        and "orders"."shipping_before_subsidy" >= 0
        and "orders"."shipping_before_subsidy" = trunc("orders"."shipping_before_subsidy")
        and "orders"."shipping_before_subsidy" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."shipping_subsidy" is not null
        and "orders"."shipping_subsidy" >= 0
        and "orders"."shipping_subsidy" = trunc("orders"."shipping_subsidy")
        and "orders"."shipping_subsidy" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."merchant_funding" is not null
        and "orders"."merchant_funding" >= 0
        and "orders"."merchant_funding" = trunc("orders"."merchant_funding")
        and "orders"."merchant_funding" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."taxable_base" is not null
        and "orders"."taxable_base" >= 0
        and "orders"."taxable_base" = trunc("orders"."taxable_base")
        and "orders"."taxable_base" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."expected_provider_payable" is not null
        and "orders"."expected_provider_payable" >= 0
        and "orders"."expected_provider_payable" = trunc("orders"."expected_provider_payable")
        and "orders"."expected_provider_payable" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."subtotal" >= 0
        and "orders"."subtotal" = trunc("orders"."subtotal")
        and "orders"."subtotal" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."discount" >= 0
        and "orders"."discount" = trunc("orders"."discount")
        and "orders"."discount" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."shipping_cost" >= 0
        and "orders"."shipping_cost" = trunc("orders"."shipping_cost")
        and "orders"."shipping_cost" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."service_fee" = 0
        and "orders"."ppn_amount" >= 0
        and "orders"."ppn_amount" = trunc("orders"."ppn_amount")
        and "orders"."ppn_amount" <= 9999999999999
        and "orders"."total" >= 0
        and "orders"."total" = trunc("orders"."total")
        and "orders"."total" <= 9999999999999

              and "orders"."provider_quoted_shipping_cost" <= 9999999999999))
        and ("orders"."provider_billed_shipping_cost" is null
          or ("orders"."provider_billed_shipping_cost" >= 0
              and "orders"."provider_billed_shipping_cost" = trunc("orders"."provider_billed_shipping_cost")
              and "orders"."provider_billed_shipping_cost" <= 9999999999999))
      )

checkout_request_accepted_result_valid.name: checkout_request_accepted_result_valid
checkout_request_accepted_result_valid.value: ("checkout_request"."status" = 'accepted' AND jsonb_typeof("checkout_request"."result") = 'object' AND "checkout_request"."result"->'version' = '1'::jsonb AND "checkout_request"."result"->>'orderId' = "checkout_request"."order_id" AND octet_length("checkout_request"."result"::text) <= 262144) IS TRUE

admin_role_grant_module_scope_shape_chec.name: admin_role_grant_module_scope_shape_check
admin_role_grant_module_scope_shape_chec.value:
((
        "admin_role_grant"."module" in ('products', 'orders', 'notifications', 'branches', 'analytics', 'audit_log')
        and "admin_role_grant"."scope" in ('own_branch', 'all_branches')
      ) or (
        "admin_role_grant"."module" in ('customers', 'homepage', 'pages', 'users', 'roles', 'footer')
        and ("admin_role_grant"."scope" = 'global' or "admin_role_grant"."scope" is null)
      )) or (
        "admin_role_grant"."module" in ('discounts', 'discount_capacity', 'prices')
        and "admin_role_grant"."action" in ('view', 'edit')
        and ("admin_role_grant"."scope" = 'global' or "admin_role_grant"."scope" is null)
      )

discount_offer_revision_window_ordered.name: discount_offer_revision_window_ordered
discount_offer_revision_window_ordered.value: "discount_offer_revision"."start_at" is null or "discount_offer_revision"."end_at" is null or "discount_offer_revision"."start_at" < "discount_offer_revision"."end_at"

discount_offer_revision_published_comple.name: discount_offer_revision_published_complete
discount_offer_revision_published_comple.value: "discount_offer_revision"."published_at" is null or ("discount_offer_revision"."name" is not null and "discount_offer_revision"."currency" is not null and "discount_offer_revision"."currency" = 'IDR' and "discount_offer_revision"."min_subtotal" is not null)

discount_offer_budget_amount_bounded.name: discount_offer_budget_amount_bounded
discount_offer_budget_amount_bounded.value: "discount_offer"."budget_amount" is null or ("discount_offer"."budget_amount" >= 0 and "discount_offer"."budget_amount" <= 9999999999999 and "discount_offer"."budget_amount" = trunc("discount_offer"."budget_amount"))

discount_offer_live_requirements.name: discount_offer_live_requirements
discount_offer_live_requirements.value: "discount_offer"."state" = 'draft' or ("discount_offer"."current_revision_id" is not null and ("discount_offer"."quota_count" is not null or "discount_offer"."budget_amount" is not null))

discount_redemption_event_transition_val.name: discount_redemption_event_transition_valid
discount_redemption_event_transition_val.value:
("discount_redemption_event"."kind" = 'reserved' and "discount_redemption_event"."previous_status" is null and "discount_redemption_event"."next_status" = 'reserved')
        or ("discount_redemption_event"."kind" = 'consumed' and "discount_redemption_event"."previous_status" = 'reserved' and "discount_redemption_event"."next_status" = 'consumed')
        or ("discount_redemption_event"."kind" = 'released' and "discount_redemption_event"."previous_status" = 'reserved' and "discount_redemption_event"."next_status" = 'released')
        or ("discount_redemption_event"."kind" = 'late_paid_review' and "discount_redemption_event"."previous_status" = 'released' and "discount_redemption_event"."next_status" = 'released')

discount_redemption_activation_kind.name: discount_redemption_activation_kind
discount_redemption_activation_kind.value:
("discount_redemption"."activation_kind" = 'public' and "discount_redemption"."code_id" is null)
        or ("discount_redemption"."activation_kind" = 'manual_only' and "discount_redemption"."code_id" is not null)

discount_redemption_terminal_timestamps.name: discount_redemption_terminal_timestamps
discount_redemption_terminal_timestamps.value:
("discount_redemption"."status" = 'reserved' and "discount_redemption"."consumed_at" is null and "discount_redemption"."released_at" is null)
        or ("discount_redemption"."status" = 'consumed' and "discount_redemption"."consumed_at" is not null and "discount_redemption"."released_at" is null)
        or ("discount_redemption"."status" = 'released' and "discount_redemption"."released_at" is not null and "discount_redemption"."consumed_at" is null)

order_discount_allocation_shape_valid.name: order_discount_allocation_shape_valid
order_discount_allocation_shape_valid.value:
("order_discount_allocation"."component" = 'markdown' and "order_discount_allocation"."order_item_id" is not null and "order_discount_allocation"."markdown_revision_id" is not null and "order_discount_allocation"."redemption_id" is null and "order_discount_allocation"."benefit_id" is null)
        or ("order_discount_allocation"."component" = 'offer_goods' and "order_discount_allocation"."order_item_id" is not null and "order_discount_allocation"."markdown_revision_id" is null and "order_discount_allocation"."redemption_id" is not null and "order_discount_allocation"."benefit_id" is not null)
        or ("order_discount_allocation"."component" = 'offer_shipping' and "order_discount_allocation"."order_item_id" is null and "order_discount_allocation"."markdown_revision_id" is null and "order_discount_allocation"."redemption_id" is not null and "order_discount_allocation"."benefit_id" is not null)

price_change_batch_row_input_sku_shape.name: price_change_batch_row_input_sku_shape
price_change_batch_row_input_sku_shape.value: ("price_change_batch_row"."state" = 'failed' and char_length("price_change_batch_row"."input_sku") between 0 and 128) or char_length("price_change_batch_row"."input_sku") between 1 and 128

price_change_batch_row_target_shape.name: price_change_batch_row_target_shape
price_change_batch_row_target_shape.value: ("price_change_batch_row"."action" = 'set_price' and "price_change_batch_row"."target_unit_price" is not null and "price_change_batch_row"."target_unit_price" > 0) or ("price_change_batch_row"."action" = 'restore_base' and "price_change_batch_row"."target_unit_price" is null) or ("price_change_batch_row"."action" = 'invalid' and "price_change_batch_row"."target_unit_price" is null) or ("price_change_batch_row"."state" = 'failed' and "price_change_batch_row"."target_unit_price" is null)

price_change_batch_counts_bounded.name: price_change_batch_counts_bounded
price_change_batch_counts_bounded.value: "price_change_batch"."applied_count" >= 0 and "price_change_batch"."applied_count" <= 2147483647 and "price_change_batch"."unchanged_count" >= 0 and "price_change_batch"."unchanged_count" <= 2147483647 and "price_change_batch"."failed_count" >= 0 and "price_change_batch"."failed_count" <= 2147483647 and "price_change_batch"."pending_count" >= 0 and "price_change_batch"."pending_count" <= 2147483647

variant_price_revision_target_shape.name: variant_price_revision_target_shape
variant_price_revision_target_shape.value: ("variant_price_revision"."action" = 'set_price' and "variant_price_revision"."target_unit_price" > 0 and "variant_price_revision"."target_unit_price" < "variant_price_revision"."source_unit_price") or ("variant_price_revision"."action" = 'restore_base' and "variant_price_revision"."target_unit_price" is null)

variant_price_revision_effective_consist.name: variant_price_revision_effective_consistency
variant_price_revision_effective_consist.value: "variant_price_revision"."effective_unit_price" = case when "variant_price_revision"."target_unit_price" is not null then "variant_price_revision"."target_unit_price" else "variant_price_revision"."source_unit_price" end
